_about: Proposed V1 defaults. Edit freely: the app reads every number from this file. Each signal is scored 0-1, then weighted into a 0-100 watchability score.

form._how: Points per game over each team's last N matches, both teams averaged. Two in-form teams beat one.

stakes._how: League: the match matters for the title, Europe spots or relegation. Europe: league-phase cutoffs (top 8, top 24) or a knockout tie.
stakes._zones: Approximate places per league. europe = all European spots (CL+EL+ECL), relegation = direct + playoff places.
stakes._damping: Early in the season every team is close to every cutoff. Stakes are scaled by share of season played / full_weight_from_share, never below min_factor.
stakes._race_places: A team is in a race only if it is also within race_places places of the line (1st for the title, between the last Europe spot and the next, between safety and the drop).

entertainment._how: Average total goals (scored + conceded) per game across both teams' last N matches.

european_classic._how: Two clubs with at least min_meetings European matches since `since` count as a rivalry (football-data.org head-to-head, Champions League fixtures).

closeness._how: Small table gap and similar form means a tight game.

records._how: Distance to a record in data/records.json, in the record's own unit (goals, matches, points...).

revenge._how: A player or manager faces a club he left within this window (Transfermarkt data).
revenge._club: Club revenge: a club meets a side that beat it in a European match within club_window_months. Being knocked out counts more than losing a single game.

big_match._how: How big both clubs are: UEFA 5-year club coefficient. Stature = sqrt(points / points_for_full), capped at 1; the match value is home stature x away stature.

par._how: Current league position against the team's usual place (average final position over the last 5 seasons, data/league_history.json). places_start places away scores 0, places_full or more scores 1, in either direction: under par, or punching above their weight. Teams that usually finish in the top title_contender_places also count by points off the top.

competition_bonus._how: Points added to the 0-100 score. Small nudge for Europa and Conference League nights, which you flagged as underrated.

favourites._how: Your teams are outlined in gold and sorted first within a day; they get no points (boost 0).

must_watch._how: A match is must-watch if its score reaches the threshold OR it is a tier-1 rivalry. Must-watch matches rank above favourite-team matches.

story._how: The 'why watch' line: the top contributing signals, most important first, joined with a dot.

templates.revenge_knockout: {loser} were knocked out by {winner} in the {competition} {stage} ({when})
templates.giant_gap: {team} {gap} pts off the top: under par
templates.par_over: {team} usually finish {usual}: punching above their weight

story._side_templates: The card splits reasons by team: 'pair' facts give each side its own line (home_x/away_x values become x), 'team' facts go to the side named by team_field. Reasons not listed stay in the middle. 'hidden' facts show no line: the card's form bar already says it.

par_over.text: Usually finish {usual}: punching above their weight

giant_gap.text: {gap} pts off the top: under par

revenge_knockout.text: Knocked out by them in the {competition} {stage} ({when})

_weights: Relative importance. Records are switched off (too rare); they come back by adding a weight. Scores are rescaled with `scale`.

knockout_bonus._how: Raw points added for European knockout rounds (before rescaling). League-phase games get none.

scale._how: Raw points (signals + bonuses) that count as 100. Calibrated so a top fixture lands around 90.
